result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly overlaps the restaurant content and several horizontal carousels end in awkwardly clipped items.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation panel covers the lower portion of the second restaurant card, obscuring its image and likely its title/details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content, or ensure the viewport is scrolled so cards are not hidden behind the fixed navigation.

issues.description: The category row and fastest-restaurant carousel show partially clipped items at the right edge, which can look like unintended viewport overflow rather than an intentional horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear carousel affordance or spacing/peek treatment, and verify horizontal scrolling is intentional and does not cause page-level overflow.
